Committee of Supply debate on the Ministry of Education budget

Committee of Supply2 March 2026 – 3 March 2026 budget-2896, budget-2902

A Committee of Supply debate on Head K, the Ministry of Education, with Members moving cuts and the Minister and Ministers of State responding.

The debate records changes to primary and secondary education, including the GEP refresh, a single Post-Secondary Admissions Exercise from 2028, Higher Mother Tongue eligibility from Secondary 1, and more financial assistance for lower- to middle-income students from Academic Year 2026. It also records reviews of Primary 1 registration, class sizes, milestone exams and DSA, and a salary review for educators.

  • Mr Darryl David moved a $100 cut to Head K, the Ministry of Education.

    That the total sum to be allocated for Head K of the Estimates be reduced by $100
    Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)

  • The Gifted Education Programme will be discontinued in its current form and support for academically strong students refreshed.

    we will refresh how we support students with academic strengths and talents, and discontinue the Gifted Education Programme (GEP) in its current form.
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • Access to school-based programmes for academically strong students will be broadened from around 7% to 10% of the cohort.

    we will broaden access to such school-based programmes, from around 7% of the cohort today to 10%.
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • There will be 15 centres hosted by primary schools for after-school advanced modules.

    there will be 15 centres hosted by primary schools across Singapore
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • The first batch of Primary 3 students will take a standardised one-stage identification exercise this August.

    The first batch of Primary 3 students will participate in a standardised one-stage identification exercise this August
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • Students can join the centre-based modules at the end of each semester at Primary 4 and Primary 5.

    students can also join at the end of each semester at Primary 4 and Primary 5
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • From Academic Year 2026, income eligibility and financial assistance amounts were raised to benefit 31,000 more students, with about 133,000 students benefiting annually.

    From Academic Year 2026, we raised the income eligibility criteria and financial assistance amount for Singaporean students to benefit 31,000 more students from lower- to middle-income households.
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • From 2026, schools with additional manpower and funding will expand from 100 to 157.

    From this year 2026, we will devote even more resources to schools, expanding the number of schools with additional manpower and funding, from 100 to 157.
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • The first Full SBB cohort will sit the SEC examination in 2027.

    The first cohort of students under Full SBB will be sitting for the Singapore-Cambridge Secondary Education Certificate (SEC) examination in 2027
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • Admissions to junior colleges, Millennia Institute, polytechnics and ITE will be streamlined into a single Post-Secondary Admissions Exercise in 2028.

    streamline several admissions exercises into a single Post-Secondary Admissions Exercise for admissions to junior colleges, Millennia Institute, polytechnics and the Institute of Technical Education (ITE) in the year 2028
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • Students who did well in Mother Tongue at PSLE can take Higher Mother Tongue from Secondary 1 regardless of overall PSLE score.

    allow students who did well in Mother Tongue at the Primary School Leaving Examinations (PSLE) to take up Higher Mother Tongue from Secondary 1, regardless of their overall PSLE score.
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • MOE is reviewing the Primary 1 Registration Framework.

    MOE is reviewing the Primary 1 Registration Framework so that our primary schools remain open to students from different backgrounds.
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • MOE will start a series of Education Conversations.

    we will start a series of Education Conversations.
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • SkillsFuture Singapore and Workforce Singapore will be reorganised into a new Statutory Board jointly overseen by MOM and MOE.

    SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) and Workforce Singapore (WSG) would be reorganised into a new Statutory Board, jointly overseen by the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) and MOE.
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • MOE is reviewing salaries of educators, including Allied Educators and MOE Kindergarten Educators.

    MOE is reviewing the salaries of our educators, including our Allied Educators and MOE Kindergarten Educators and will share more when ready.
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • Mr Desmond Lee set out four 'Learns' for AI, beginning with learning about AI.

    First, learn about AI.
    Mr Desmond Lee

  • Choice order will be a posting tie-breaker for the new PSE, in the order citizenship, choice order, gross aggregate score and computerised balloting.

    choice order will be introduced as a posting tie-breaker for the PSE in this order: citizenship, choice order, gross aggregate score and computerised balloting.
    Mr David Neo

    Mr David Neo

    Mr David Neo

  • Funding for the Mother Tongue Language Learning and Promotion Committees will increase over the next five years.

    Mr Desmond Lee

    SEN officers have increased from about 450 in 2017 to about 750 by 2024.

    Capacity will increase from 8,300 in 2024, to 10,000 places by 2030.
    Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng

  • SPED salary guidelines were reviewed and enhanced with salary enhancements from 2024 to 2026.

    we have reviewed and enhanced the salary guidelines with salary enhancements from 2024 to 2026.
    Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi

    This includes exploring mixed mode cooling for classrooms as the science becomes clearer.

    Primary 3 to 6 students have 2.5 hours of PE classes per week.

  • Mr Desmond Lee gave the PSLE mathematics answer as 7,200 cubic centimetres for part (a) and 32 centimetres for part (b).

    For (a), it is 7,200 cubic centimetres; for (b), it is 32 centimetres.

  • Mr Darryl David asked for leave to withdraw his cut.

    I ask for leave to withdraw my cut.
    Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)

What happens next Mr Darryl David asked for leave to withdraw his cut. MOE said more details will be shared when ready on the Primary 1 Registration Framework review, salary review and Education Conversations. The 2027 SEC cohort will receive results in January 2028 and apply through the new PSE, with posting outcomes by early February.

Open questions from this debate (10)

Questions the debate raises that the record does not resolve. Listed as open questions, not as findings.

  • When will the Primary 1 Registration Framework review conclude and what changes will be made?
  • What will the new statutory board integrating SSG and WSG be named and when will it be established?
  • What is the timeline for installing mixed-mode air-conditioning in all classrooms?
  • Will class sizes be reduced, and if so, to what level and by when?
  • What are the details of the salary review for educators, Allied Educators and MOE Kindergarten Educators?
  • How will the 15 centre-based advanced module centres be allocated across Singapore?
  • What are the details of the Education Conversations, including dates and participants?
  • How will AI literacy be assessed at each level?
  • What are the outcomes of the review into milestone exams, DSA and through-train options?
  • How will the National School Mental Well-Being Charter proposed by Dr Charlene Chen be implemented?
